reconstruction.scope: Standing Osireion open megalithic hall/excavation: two rows of five massive plain square granite piers with worn bases/fractured surviving heights, incomplete longitudinal lintels and loose cap blocks. Coursed perimeter masonry with recessed rectangular door/niche bays, exposed central wet stone island/rectangular floor recesses and shallow opaque green-water moat in the pictured low-water state. Narrow timber side stair/bridge with simple rails. Complete opaque excavation floor and fitted retaining/earth rim meet a bounded mapped ground opening. No intact ancient roof, covered underground rooms/long passage, copied relief/graffiti or neighboring Seti I temple reconstruction.
